description: This file defines the EmptyNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing an empty node in the template AST with no children and no additional functionality beyond its parent.

classes.name: Twig\Node\EmptyNode
classes.description: A class representing an empty node in the Twig template AST, which cannot have child nodes and extends the base Node class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmptyNode, calling the parent constructor with empty children and attributes.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Attempts to set a child node but throws a LogicException since EmptyNode cannot have children.
